title: exploreDE declared mapping (uns['exploreDE']['mapping'])
description: Validates the declared-mapping block a canonical exploreDE/1.0 .h5ad may carry at uns['exploreDE']['mapping'] -- WEW's 'dictionary' (see plans/anndata_manifest_design.md): for THIS dataset, which raw column/matrix supplies each concept exploreDE cares about (p-value, fdr, log2fc/ratio, feature id/symbol, domain-specific extras like nrPeptides or SaintScore), kept in the file instead of re-guessed from a growing list of hardcoded column-name regexes. Written by build_explore_h5ad()'s `de_columns` / `rowdata_columns` arguments; consumed by ExploreDatasetH5AD (the `de` block) and otherwise kept for self-description/provenance. Two groups exist today: `de` (DE stat + optional extra-score columns, per contrast or shared default) and `feature` (feature id/symbol/description column, dataset-wide). Count-matrix naming needs no separate block -- the names given in build_explore_h5ad()'s `counts` argument ARE that dictionary entry already. Extend this schema in lockstep with new mapping keys in the R code, never ahead of it.

significanceKind.description: Direction of a significance axis: which side of a threshold counts as significant.

deSemantics.description: For one contrast (or the shared default): which source column fed each canonical DE target, plus the display-only semantics for the optional extra score and the fdr axis's direction.

effect_log2fc_col.description: Source column that supplied the log2 fold-change/ratio.

score_pvalue_col.description: Source column that supplied the raw p-value.

score_fdr_col.description: Source column that supplied the FDR/adjusted p-value.

score_col.description: Source column that supplied the optional extra score (e.g. SaintScore).

score_label.description: Display label for the optional extra scored column (e.g. 'SaintScore', 'nrPeptides').

deMapping.description: Global default plus optional per-contrast overrides, merged at read time. Resolution order everywhere in exploreDE: explicit mapping > canonical slot > heuristic detection.

contrasts.description: Keyed by the same contrast identifiers as uns['de']. Only contrasts that need an override are present.

featureMapping.description: Explicit override of which rowData column supplies the feature id / symbol / description, for producers whose column names don't match built-in auto-detection. Declared via build_explore_h5ad()'s `rowdata_columns` argument; only entries actually consulted are recorded (auto-detected columns stay implicit).

id_col.description: Source column supplying the feature identifier (gene/protein/etc. id).

symbol_col.description: Source column supplying the feature's display symbol/name.

description_col.description: Source column supplying the feature's free-text description.
